title: Remotion animation pipeline test 2, complex sprite animations.
author: CouldaBeen_TheBest
selftext:
Last time I posted this workflow as a proof of concept without much time put into it. This second run was made using my improved sprite animation pipeline.

Concept art generated in Midjourney following a specific set of instructions to create a character with simplified hands and clear shape language. Then that concept art is run through a separate image generator ai, gemini or chatgpt, and turned into a right facing pseudo-sprite. Pixellab.ai converts it into a real sprite. Then a similar process is run with keyframes from reference. 

The issue I'm tackling right now is sprite consistency which I have a few ideas for. Music in Suno, sound effects are a mix of generated code and free asset packs.

replies.author: CouldaBeen_TheBest
replies.body: I'm attempting a skeleton driven flow next, but if you have any specifics I'd look into it.

replies.author: hard_farter
replies.body: For starters, you can't see the jerky, obvious end-of-loop in the walking?

replies.author: CouldaBeen_TheBest
replies.body: Sure, that's one frame that's off but there's plenty of those one frame jitters. I thought you were looking at something I hadn't already seen. That's why I mentioned consistency as what I'm tackling next in the post.

replies.author: hard_farter
replies.body: when the person is knocked upward onto the counter it looks like they do a weird impossible movement, almost like they wiggle in the air in odd ways like they're being dragged around by a mouse

replies.author: CouldaBeen_TheBest
replies.body: Got it, movement ramping. Thanks, that's helpful. During my early drafts I noticed that movement ramping on runs and walks also looked awkward so adding a smoothing pass for the next run.

comments.author: songokuthegreat
comments.body:
Excellent work here, man! This looks really exciting. I really like how the environments transition based on how hard you knock out someone (like Tekken and Dragon Ball FighterZ).   
I hope Amelie is the main character for this series; I look forward to seeing where you end up going with this.

replies.author: CouldaBeen_TheBest
replies.body: Thank you. For the next phase with the updates to animation and consistency I'm hoping for a big jump in quality. Amelie will make an appearance too, as will Kushner's brother.
